name: antigravity-aistudio
description: Cloud offloading and workflow automation for Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/) through Antigravity's built-in browser subagent. Offload reasoning, long-context analysis, prompt engineering, few-shot tuning, parameter optimization, and code export to conserve Antigravity desktop app quota.
suggestedPrompts: Analyze a large multi-file codebase architecture by offloading context to Google AI Studio with Gemini Pro
Construct and evaluate a few-shot structured prompt with JSON response schema in Google AI Studio
Tune Gemini model hyperparameters and safety settings in Google AI Studio, then export production Python code
Audit live Google AI Studio web UI capabilities and model availability with aistudio-ui-sync-audit
